notes: Rotondo's Shark on the engine's bot brain: its hole brick keeps one shark, drawn with its own model. The port makes it a swimmer that keeps to its water, bites for this copy's damage, is painted the first of its colours with white fins, and in a mini-game dies after 9 seconds out of water (3 of Bot_Hole's 3-second loops). Its script sets every speed to 0 and nothing in it says how v20 moved it, so its speeds are chosen here: 10 forward, 5 back, 8 sideways in water, and a slow flop on land. Not ported yet: grabbing a player in its mouth and killing them 5 seconds later, its random colours and the rare Cool Shark, the swim animation, its hole brick hiding itself, and its huge bounding box (it collides as a Blockhead).

handles.SharkHoleBot::onEnterLiquid: nothing to do: water never hurts a swimmer here
